summary: Klamath County Forest Service lookout: a 41-foot tower with an R-6 cab, built 1964-65 by sources that differ by a year, and listed as staffed in recent seasons.

facts.design: 15x15-foot R-6 flattop live-in cab with catwalk on a 41-foot treated timber tower

access.note: Cherylhill lists the site as accessible to the public; that is not access to the lookout cab itself. No source says the cab is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: Register 2021 visit report: directions to the tower are signed

events.note: Road built to the summit with Accelerated Public Works Program funds; a trailer and open platform served the 1963 fire season while the tower was built
Weebly: 42-foot treated timber tower with R-6 cabin constructed
Register and FireLookout.com date the tower to 1965; the Register says it first went into service that year
Staffed during the 2018 and 2019 seasons, per the May 2021 Register visit report (one visitor's account)

corrections.why: The Register and FireLookout.com both give a 41-foot tower (12.5 m). The 50-foot figure appears on Weebly only as a tower under construction in 1963; Weebly's finished-tower figure is 42 feet. No source gives 50 feet for the finished tower.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Weebly dates construction to 1964 (42-foot tower). The Register and FireLookout.com give 1965. Both dates are kept as events; the sources do not agree.
The Register and FireLookout.com say 41 feet; Weebly says 42 feet. Facts use 41 feet (12.5 m) from the Register.
The Register gives 6,374 ft (1,943 m), which matches the record's 1942.8 m. FireLookout.com and Cherylhill give 6,421 ft. The Register figure is kept.
The Register and Weebly say Fremont National Forest; Cherylhill says Fremont Winema National Forest. The Register is used for agency and forest name.

notes_for_editor: Brief's height_m 15.2 (50 ft) is corrected to 41 ft (12.5 m); the 50-foot figure is only a 1963 under-construction note. Build year differs by one year across sources (1964 vs 1965) and both are recorded. No fire is named in any source read. A waymarking.com snippet says the tower was erected in 1967; it was only a search snippet, not read, and not used. Staffing as_of is the Cherylhill directory date (July 2026); the 2018-2019 staffing comes from a single visitor report (the visit report's author) and should be treated as one source. Access level 'public' refers to the site only.
